1084-4279-5708.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-5708.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-5708.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2023-3755-4518-6965.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1115-2023-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-2279-4247-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-4247-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

5170-6132-6634-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5315-5359-6972.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

792-1580-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Totentanz trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5147-6255.notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
2946-4871-5147-6255.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7782.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2169-5256--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-3605-4812-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2034-5007.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
628-2034-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

703-4661-7149.description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Vesuvan Doppelganger into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Vesuvan Doppelgangers into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Vesuvan Doppelganger tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-4661-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1010-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

985-3713-3755-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2557-4682-5140-6753.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2557-4682-5140-6753.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2557-4682-5140-6753.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1251-2366-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
1251-2366-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

3532-3594-5078-5645.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

341-1965-2034-5224.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {1} due to Umori, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Omarthis.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Omarthis, adding {C}{C}.
When Omarthis dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Omarthis from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

549-1651-5640-6859.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Servant of Tymaret, targeting Servant of Tymaret.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat
549-1651-5640-6859.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

2173-4905-5220-6559.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-5223-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1680-4508-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
1680-4508-6847.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Runed Stalactite, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

3698-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
3698-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Grinding Station and Simulacrum Synthesizer trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Simulacrum Synthesizer trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
When the Construct enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 one additional time.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 7.
Repeat from step 6.

3532-5078-5901-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-5901-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-2231-5220--53.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
2034-2231-5220--53.notes: If the creature can be cast using {C} or less, the combo nets infinite colorless mana.

539-4188-4657.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
539-4188-4657.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

1486-1753-2085-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-2085-4452.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.
1486-1753-2085-4452.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1491-2313-2757-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2313-2757-6218.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

4779-5361-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
4779-5361-5365.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Auton Soldier's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.
4779-5361-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

uses.n: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch // Temple of Cyclical Time

5550-5551-5686.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
5550-5551-5686.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 4.

277-1308-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
277-1308-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-1308-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Tiller Engine triggers, untapping both Everywhere tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

974-5200-5470.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Ghired.
974-5200-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.
974-5200-5470.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-4996.description:
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling Beacon of Immortality into your library.
Vito triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

851-2665-2743.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating two token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1367-1817-3039-4450.description:
Cast Carth the Lion by paying {2}{B}{G}.
In response, cast Double Major by paying {U}{G}, creating a nonlegendary copy of the Carth the Lion spell.
Resolve both spells, causing two copies of Carth the Lion to enter the battlefield.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat from step 4.

1770-3334-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1770-3334-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1642-5605.manaNeeded: {6}{B}{B} at most plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1642-5605.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has a life total of 40 or higher.
Warlock Class is level three.
1642-5605.description:
Cast Torgaar either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at most {6}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Torgaar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose an amount of life equal to their life total minus 20.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

191-1689-5436.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
191-1689-5436.description:
Activate Witch-king Angmar by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to draw a card due to Eligeth.
Resolve the Witch-king Angmar ability.
Repeat.

2660-2707-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Walk the Aeons is put on the bottom of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library during your draw step due to River Song.
Repeat.

3025-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
3025-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

777-1913-3685-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding {C}{C}.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Necron Warriors, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {6}.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying a permanent.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each of your turns.

776-1329-4021-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4021-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Cathar's Shield to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Cathar's Shield.
Cast Cathar's Shield.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
